card.name: Digits inside numbers in tables
card.fires_on: Digits, decimal points, or spaces inside numbers in dose tables and lists of counts, right where the next digit is about to appear.

modes.label: Decimal point in a dose
modes.description: The decimal point between digits in a volume or dose figure in a table.

modes.label: Space before a count
modes.description: The space after a comma or between numbers, just before the next number in a list or table.

modes.label: Digit within a number
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number or in a quantity before mL.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of numbers in tables and lists, as the next digit is about to be written.
